d: Bihar ke hajipur men pradhanmantri ke bihar pahunchne se pahle postar ko lekar bara vivad khara ho gaya hai. soshal midiya par ek vidiyo teji se vayral ho raha hai, jismen trak par charhkar pradhanmantri aur mukhyamantri ka postar pharte hue dekha ja sakta hai. is ghatna ka vidiyo samne aane ke bad ilake men siyasi mahaul garma gaya hai.
